part.text: Perfect! Appium is available. Let me create a Python script to automate the interaction with the Bluesky app:

input.command:
cat > /tmp/automate_bluesky.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3

from appium import webdriver
from appium.webdriver.common.appiumby import AppiumBy
from appium.options.ios import XCUITestAppOptions
import time

# Set up the desired capabilities
options = XCUITestAppOptions()
options.bundle_id = "xyz.blueskyweb.app"
options.udid = "85DBBAE1-AA2F-4286-A1E5-9D0F4518AFB3"
options.automation_name = "XCUITest"

# Initialize the Appium driver
driver = webdriver.Remote('http://localhost:4723', options=options)

try:
    # Wait for the app to be ready
    time.sleep(2)
    
    # Find the repost button on the first post
    # The repost icon is typically the second icon in the row of interaction buttons
    repost_buttons = driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//XCUIElementTypeButton[@name='Repost']")
    
    if repost_buttons:
        print(f"Found {len(repost_buttons)} repost button(s)")
        # Click the first repost button
        repost_buttons[0].click()
        time.sleep(1)
        
        # Look for "Quote post" option
        quote_post_option = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//XCUIElementTypeButton[@name='Quote post']")
        quote_post_option.click()
        time.sleep(1)
        
        # Find the text input field and type the comment
        text_input = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//XCUIElementTypeTextView")
        text_input.send_keys("sharing this")
        time.sleep(1)
        
        # Find and click the post button
        post_button = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//XCUIElementTypeButton[@name='Post']")
        post_button.click()
        
        print("Quote post created successfully!")
    else:
        print("Could not find repost button")
        # Try alternative selectors
        all_buttons = driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//XCUIElementTypeButton")
        print(f"Found {len(all_buttons)} buttons total")
        for i, btn in enumerate(all_buttons[:10]):
            try:
                print(f"Button {i}: {btn.get_attribute('name')}")
            except:
                pass

finally:
    driver.quit()

EOF
